newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corp bond debt issuers pause to size up rates.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corp bond debt issuers pause to size up rates.

text.p: A quiet day may be on the agenda for the corporate new issue market as issuers step back to size up the interest rate environment before taking the plunge into the debt arena, syndicate sources said.
"It's tough to tell what today's business will be like, everyone's just watching the (Treasury) market," said one syndicate source.
However, dealers said that Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc is expected to launch its $1.2 billion multi-tranche debt offering as early as Wednesday, syndicate sources said.
